title: Observe public release and record closeout
description: Observe actual public artifacts and required fresh consumer behavior, then retain version-scoped outcomes separately from sealed candidate inputs. It does not infer public success from generation or local qualification.
inputs: Attempted release identity, candidate/approval/publication facts, and required public observation contract.
Actual registry/assets/installed-consumer observations, permitted diagnostic timing, and known unavailable evidence.
outputs: Durable version-scoped closeout with public identity, check outcomes, actual event facts, limitations, and follow-up.
Explicit unavailable, failed-after-publication, partial reporting, or still-pending closeout state.
behavior: Observe registry version/channel/integrity, hosted artifact identities, and required fresh public CLI/version/target-install results.
Preserve exact candidate and approval attribution, separate policy/expectations from observed results, and use the retained evidence formats and routing.
Make closeout rerunnable without changing sealed inputs or repeating publication.
When required public evidence is unavailable, expose the gap and leave pending records and unrelated files unchanged except requested logs.
Collect available phase-duration diagnostics automatically; keep missing timing nonblocking, malformed emitted timing a diagnostic defect, and identity/outcome evidence mandatory.

failure_behavior.condition: Public identity or required fresh smoke is unavailable or failed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the specific unavailable or failed-after-publication scope without inventing successful closeout.

failure_behavior.condition: Durable reporting fails after a public write.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report incomplete closeout and preserve the known publication basis; do not republish to repair reporting.
Report the diagnostic limit without substituting fabricated durations or masking mandatory publication evidence.
